title: fix(components,plugin-detail): the block-level nested aria bags render through the shared reader (objectui#11083, batch 2)
body:
Fixes #11083
Clause-②: no

The nine block-level members of this card now render the accessible name an author declares in the spec's nested `aria` bag. Each one reads the bag through `resolveInlineAriaProps` from `@object-ui/react` against `useDisplayLocale()`, keeps its own defaults at the call site, and adds no default role. No mapping table of the bag lives in any of the touched files. Batch 1 (PR objectui#11102) put the page root, `ListView` and `useRecordAriaProps` on the same reader; with this PR every row the card carries is repaired, which is why the first line names the card.

## Measured first

Before any repair, each of the nine was mounted through the real `SchemaRenderer` and registry at `origin/main` `fe41dc76a`, under `en` and `zh`, with `properties: { aria: { ariaLabel } }` (for the chat blocks, `properties: { feed: { aria: { ariaLabel } } }`), once with a plain string and once with a locale map. Each block rendered its content (text present, no "Unknown component" panel).

| block | before (en and zh, plain and map) | this PR |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `element:text_input` | no `aria-label` anywhere | repaired: on the input |
| `element:record_picker` | no `aria-label` anywhere | repaired: on the combobox trigger |
| `element:metadata_viewer` | no `aria-label` anywhere | repaired: on a new root `div` |
| `page:header` | no `aria-label` anywhere | repaired: on the `header` element, both layouts |
| `page:tabs` | no `aria-label` anywhere | repaired: on the `Tabs` root |
| `page:card` | no `aria-label` anywhere | repaired: on the `Card` root |
| `page:accordion` | no `aria-label` anywhere | repaired: on the `Accordion` root, both variants |
| `record:chatter` `feed` | no such `aria-label` (only the timeline's own "Discussion" / "讨论") | repaired: on a new `div` around the timeline |
| `record:discussion` `feed` | same as `record:chatter` | repaired: same renderer |

No row is "already resolving" and none is "no renderer". The order's mechanism assumption 1.4 did not hold: the three `element:*` types do have renderers. They register under the bare keys `text_input`, `record_picker` and `metadata_viewer` with `namespace: 'element'`, so a grep for the full type string finds no registration. The installed spec (`@objectstack/spec` 17.4.0) declares `aria` on all seven block schemas and `feed.aria` on both chat blocks, and a locale-map `aria.ariaLabel` parses on each.

The two pin files below are the census evidence: every row above is a set of pinned cases, and the reverse run shows they were red on the old renderers.

## What changed

- **`page:header`, `page:tabs`, `page:card`, `page:accordion`** (`containers.tsx`). Each spreads `resolveInlineAriaProps(schema?.aria, displayLocale)` on the block's own root element, the one that already carries `className` and the designer props. `SchemaRenderer` hoists `properties.aria` onto the node, as it does for the page root. `page:tabs` names the `Tabs` root, not the tab list, so an authored `role` cannot replace the list's `tablist` role. One comment block above `page:tabs` covers the four sites.
- **`element:text_input`.** The bag lands on the input, the element that carries the field's name, as `element:button`'s bag lands on its button. This site already has a default description: the id of its description paragraph in `aria-describedby`. An authored `ariaDescribedBy` is **added after** that id, not put in its place, because `aria-describedby` is a list of ids and the paragraph still describes the field. The published description of the `description` input said an absent description leaves the input with no `aria-describedby`; that sentence now says how the two compose.
- **`element:record_picker`.** The bag lands on the `SelectTrigger`, the `combobox` button that `label`'s `htmlFor` already names. The trigger keeps Radix's `combobox` role unless an author declares another. The published `label` input description now says a declared `aria.ariaLabel` wins over the label text as the combobox's name.
- **`element:metadata_viewer`.** Each view returns its own root (a loading line, a warning, or the card), so the block had no single element to carry the bag. The dispatcher now renders an always-present `div` around the view that carries the resolved bag. With nothing authored it has no attribute. The `div` is not conditional: a wrapper that appeared only when the bag resolved would remount the view whenever that changed.
- **The `feed` of `record:chatter` / `record:discussion`** (`RecordChatterPanel.tsx`). The spec's `feed` is `RecordActivityProps`, so `feed.aria` is read the way `record:activity` reads its own bag: through `useRecordAriaProps` (built on the shared reader since batch 1), onto a `div` around the embedded timeline, as `record-activity.tsx` puts its bag on the `div` around its timeline. The `record:*` defaults come with it: no role while nothing is authored, and `region` to carry an authored name. The timeline keeps its heading as its own name (the objectui#9998 rule). The block's top-level `aria` still names the renderer's outer container, so the two bags name two different regions. The `div` is present in both panel layouts and is always rendered, so the timeline and a half-typed comment are never remounted. The read is in the panel, not in `record-chatter.tsx`, because the panel already receives `config.feed` and owns both timeline mounts, so no prop or exported type changes. `record-chatter.tsx`'s header note, which recorded `aria` as unread on this path, now says where both bags are read.
- **Docs.** `content/docs/layout/page-header.mdx` (Accessibility) describes the bag on `page:header` and the three sibling page blocks. `content/docs/plugins/plugin-detail.mdx` (the chatter callout) describes `feed.aria`.
- **Changeset.** `patch` for `@object-ui/components` and `@object-ui/plugin-detail`. No export, type or accepted set moves; the keys already validated.

## Tests

All runs are from the worktree root with root-relative paths, through `os-verify-lock`, at head `c9f82b651`.

- New pins:
  - `packages/components/src/__tests__/block-nested-aria-11083.test.tsx`: 9 site rows (the seven blocks, plus the second `page:header` layout and the `allowMultiple` accordion). Each row asserts that a plain string under en and zh, and a locale map under en and zh, name exactly the row's carrier element, found without reading any ARIA attribute. Each row also asserts that `ariaDescribedBy` and `role` reach the carrier. Default cases: no ARIA attribute and no role when nothing is authored; the tab list keeps its role; the picker keeps `combobox`; text_input's description id stays first. The lit control is `element:text`. 50 tests.
  - `packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/__tests__/recordChatterFeedAria-11083.test.tsx`: both block names, both layouts (`bottom` and `right`). A plain string and a locale map under en and zh name a region around the timeline, read off the accessibility tree. Also covered: described-by and role, an attribute-less wrapper with no `feed.aria`, and the block's own name and the feed's name on two different regions. 26 tests.
- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-detail/`: `Test Files  223 passed | 1 skipped (224)`, `Tests  2192 passed | 8 skipped (2200)`.
- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/components/`: `Test Files  335 passed | 1 skipped (336)`, `Tests  3281 passed | 24 skipped (3305)`. This includes batch 1's `page-root-aria-11083`.
- 85 files outside those two packages: every test file naming one of the nine blocks, `RecordChatterPanel` or the metadata viewer, plus `plugin-markdown`'s tests (the metadata fence mounts the viewer) and batch 1's `ListView.nestedAriaSharedReader-11083`. Two of the three suites that mock `@object-ui/react` and touch these blocks are in this set; the third is in the `plugin-detail` run above. Result: `Test Files  85 passed (85)`, `Tests  2232 passed (2232)`.
- Reverse run, on the committed fix: the five source files were checked out at the base `fe41dc76a` inside a script with a `trap` restore. On-disk proof: each file's blob equals its base blob, and the reader-call count is 0 in each. The predicted outcome was 71 red and 5 green. The 5 green are the lit control, the no-bag defaults, the picker's `combobox` role, and the two `bottom`-layout wrapper-less cases, which had an attribute-less parent before too. Measured: `Tests  71 failed | 5 passed (76)`. Restore proven: each blob equals HEAD again, and `git diff HEAD` is empty. No `dist` is involved: both files import the renderers from `src`, and the root vitest config aliases every `@object-ui/*` to `src`.
- Type-check: the dependency closure was built first (`pnpm --workspace-concurrency=2 --filter '@object-ui/components^...' --filter '@object-ui/plugin-detail^...' build`, 12 projects, VERDICT 0). Then `pnpm --filter @object-ui/components type-check` exited 0 and `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-detail type-check` exited 0, each captured separately (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`). `--listFiles` on each test project lists the new pin file once.

## Gates

At head `c9f82b651`, each exited 0: `check-changeset-presence` (8 source files of 2 released packages, 1 changeset), `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-changeset-claims` (report-only; the 9 pending changesets that name a touched file were read, and none is falsified), `check-pending-changeset-literals`, `check-control-bytes`, `check-new-cross-file-line-citations` (0 new), `check-doc-component-types`, `check-doc-fence-languages`, `check-doc-example-ids`, `check-doc-links`, `check-test-path-roots`, the three `check-vi-mock-*`, `check-unreferenced-sources`, `check-phantom-dependencies`, `check-unused-dependencies`, `check-handler-key-read-sites`, `check-doc-example-shared-reader`, `check-lint-rule-coverage`, `check-registry-bare-name-collisions` and `check-element-data-source-declaration`.

eslint on the 8 changed ts/tsx files: exit 0, 0 errors. The `--format json` count is 8 files. Of the 129 warnings, 128 are on untouched lines. The other one is the metadata viewer renderer's unchanged `{ schema: any }` signature, which the diff shows as added only because the function moved below the new `MetadataView`. The population is `eslint.config.js` `files: ['**/*.{ts,tsx}']`, and no `parserOptions.project` or `projectService` is set, so linting is not type-aware and this diff cannot change an untouched file's result.

NOT MEASURED locally, declared to CI: `pnpm lint` repo-wide, the full `pnpm test` farm, and `check:eager-closure` / `check:sdui-registration-pins` / `check:doc-snippets` (each needs a console or docs-scope build).

## Acceptance notes

- **No default role, by the card's direction.** An `aria-label` on the role-less roots (the `Tabs`, `Card` and `Accordion` roots, and the metadata viewer's `div`) is not exposed without an authored `role`. `page:header`'s `header` element exposes it depending on where the header sits. This is the page-root situation batch 1 recorded; it stays with the element-family default-role card triage kept separate.
- **An authored `role` replaces the carrier's own** on text_input (`textbox`) and record_picker (`combobox`). That is the precedence every other site of the reader ships, and it is pinned.
- **A pending changeset now reads narrower than the renderer.** `.changeset/text-input-description-aria-describedby-5735.md` says an absent `description` leaves the input with no `aria-describedby`. That is still true when no `aria.ariaDescribedBy` is authored, and this PR's changeset states the composition. It is not edited here.
